verdict.rationale: Numeral explicitly promises to register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions on time, backs this with an on-time filing guarantee covering penalties and interest, and supports this with autofile/autoregister features and continual nexus monitoring so filings occur in all jurisdictions where liability exists. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of the guarantee being honored in practice, and detail on guarantee scope/exclusions (e.g., late data submission by customer).
